definitions.gloss: preparation; arrangement; plan; schedule of steps
definitions.explanation: The organized sequence of steps or preparations needed to accomplish something smoothly.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{段取|だんど}りを{決|き}めよう。
examples.english: Let's decide on the arrangements for the meeting.

examples.japanese: {段取|だんど}りが{悪|わる}くて{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took a long time because the planning was poor.

examples.japanese: {段取|だんど}り{通|どお}りに{進|すす}めてください。
examples.english: Please proceed according to the plan.

notes:
ORIGIN:
Originally a theater term referring to the steps ({段|だん}) of a plot or the arrangement of scenes.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{段取|だんど}りを{組|く}む / {立|た}てる (to make arrangements/plans)
・{段取|だんど}りが{良|よ}い / {悪|わる}い (good/bad planning)
・{段取|だんど}り{通|どお}りに (according to plan)
・{段取|だんど}り{八分|はちぶ} (good preparation is 80% of success)

USAGE NOTE:
{段取|だんど}り emphasizes the practical sequence of steps rather than abstract planning. It's commonly used in work contexts where efficiency matters.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{準備|じゅんび} (preparation) - general preparation
・{手順|てじゅん} (procedure) - specific sequence of steps
・{段取|だんど}り - focuses on organizing workflow efficiently
